name: Tencent Docs Extensions
name_zh: 腾讯文档扩展工具（社区版）
description: Use Tencent Docs form and Open API extensions not packaged in the official connector.
description_zh: 使用官方连接器未打包的收集表编辑发布、权限、协作者和批量插图等扩展功能。
description_en: Use form publishing, permissions, collaborators, batch image insertion, and other Tencent Docs extensions absent from the official connector.
examples_zh: 检查这份腾讯文档收集表的题目和发布状态
把这份收集表的题目替换后发布，并验证公开链接
列出这份腾讯文档的协作者和完整权限
把这些图片批量插入腾讯文档表格
examples_en: Inspect the questions and release state of this Tencent Docs form
Replace the questions, publish the form, and verify its public URL
List collaborators and detailed permissions for this Tencent Docs file
Batch insert these images into a Tencent Docs spreadsheet
